subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a repaired rebased PR with live Feishu/CardKit proof, or accept a proof override after sanctioned verification?
rationale: The external contributor cannot produce a live Feishu tenant capture, and ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output plus mocked tests as sufficient proof for a visible Feishu channel change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current conflict, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override Proof After Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accepting the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled together with the broader Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, resolve the current conflict, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have recent Feishu reply/streaming history, making them the best available owner for the proof override or branch disposition decision.
